summary.text: Heavenly Lotus Sect, named among Central Continent's top ten sects.

claims.text: Immortal Crane Sect elites bound for Fairy Bai Hu’s inheritance are told that Heavenly Lotus Sect, Spirit Butterfly Valley, Ancient Soul Sect, Heaven’s Envy Sect, and other Central Continent rivals will also contest that inheritance, so the disciples must stay united on the trip.

At the sect’s location, rank eight fighting turns an enormous area into desolate land with sand covering the sky, deep craters burning with fire or piled with ice, thunder still rumbling, and a river of blood flowing through the battlefield. The original mountainous terrain that held famous mountains and rivers with profound natural dao marks is completely changed. The central rank eight Immortal Gu House Heavenly Pool looks from outside like a small pool among the world’s smallest Immortal Gu Houses, filled with green lotuses some open and some closed, each holding a blessed land or grotto-heaven.

Five Virtues Sect’s past leader had been an elder of Heavenly Lotus Sect. Heavenly Lotus Sect is one of the ten great ancient sects of Central Continent and a super force, which is why Five Virtues Sect could develop without nearby forces sidelining it.

Heavenly Pool is named as the location of Heavenly Lotus Sect, still far beyond the horizon. Yu Mu Chun identifies Illusion Garden as Heavenly Lotus Sect’s Immortal Gu House, built on illusion path over three hundred years earlier by Illusion Demon Immortal Huang Xiao.

At the location of Heavenly Lotus Sect, rank eight fighting turns an enormous area into desolate land of craters, fire, ice, thunder, and a flowing blood river. The site held famous mountains and rivers with profound natural dao marks; without those, the landscape would be ruined even more severely. Three Immortal Gu Houses hover afterward: Canary Pavilion, Yue Yang Palace, and the rank eight Heavenly Pool. Heavenly Pool looks like a small pool filled with green lotuses, each holding a blessed land or grotto-heaven, and is called the base of Heavenly Lotus Sect, created by Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable to store immortal apertures.

Mu Ling Lan says Heavenly Lotus Sect was created by Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable and owns the highest number of Immortal Gu Houses among the compared forces. The same talk lists Canary Pavilion, Yue Yang Palace, and Heavenly Pool as already known, and adds that Heavenly Lotus Sect recently created a fourth Immortal Gu House in secret.
